svg.title: GPU memory each step needs
svg.desc: A horizontal bar chart. The horizontal axis is the GPU memory the source lists, in GB, from 0 to 80. The vertical axis lists six steps. Course stack (hosted API): no bar, no GPU assumed. openpi, run the model: more than 8 GB. GR00T, run the model: 16 GB or more. openpi, LoRA fine-tuning: more than 22.5 GB. GR00T, fine-tuning: 40 GB or more, recommended. openpi, full fine-tuning: more than 70 GB.
